correctness.rationale: The 001 constraint forces every bit after two consecutive zeros to be zero. Thus any queried adjacent pair with a later queried position defeats shattering by the 00...1 trace. Otherwise all unqueried positions may be set to one, unless the unique final queried adjacent pair is 00, when its later suffix is set to zero. The supports partition uniquely into independent sets and a final pair preceded by an independent set. Exact path-polynomial counting and VC rank follow. A wholly independent oracle reproduced all 8,190 support decisions for n=1..12.

value.rationale: A single forbidden substring defines a canonical regular language and a basic class for VC geometry of constrained words. The theorem supplies complete membership of every possible shattered coordinate support, an exact face series and a structural terminal-double rule, not merely an asymptotic VC bound or a numerical exercise.
